manifest.strict_temporal_filter: season < target_season OR (season == target_season AND round < target_round)
manifest.race_fp_contract: Historical and test quali_position are event-prequential policy-blended predictions; qualifying-derived features are rederived. Actual qualifying is target-only and never a race-FP predictor.
manifest.race_metric_population: Full field ranked; MAE/correlation evaluated on 05_train_models.py::classified_finisher_mask

summary.selection_guidance: Select from paired race-event deltas, with Monaco R8 and Hungary R13 reported explicitly. Driver rows are diagnostic only.
